name: evening_congestion
title: Evening congestion
description: Everything slows by about 45 percent at peak hours and nothing breaks. A detector that flags this is one you uninstall within a week.

card.title: The far end is slow to answer
card.summary: Your router and the path out to the internet both look normal, but the services we test are taking 83 ms to send their first byte, about 66 ms more than the network itself explains.
remediation: Check whether other sites are fine; if they are, the problem is at the far end and not with your connection.
Check the service's own status page.
Wait a few minutes; this often clears on its own.

card.title: This device looks like the problem
card.summary: The signals that changed are on this machine rather than on the network around it: CPU 12%, 1.5% of connections retransmitted.
remediation: Close whatever is using the most CPU or bandwidth on this device.
Restart this device's network adapter.
Check for an update to this device's network adapter driver.
